0022600189.text: The Denver Nuggets (3-3, 4th in the Northwest and 10th in the West, on a one-game losing streak) are the designated road team against the Indiana Pacers (3-6, 3rd in the Central and 10th in the East, on a one-game winning streak) in this regular-season NBA Mexico City Game at a neutral site in Mexico City, Denver's eighth game of the season. Denver is missing DeMar DeRozan (back spasms), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Kelly Oubre Jr. (calf bruise), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Nuggets won both meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently 135-120 in Indianapolis on December 3, 2025.
